## User
Use a minimal tool sequence to exercise filesystem tools, then exit.
Required steps: 1. Read a small existing file or directory listing using a tool. 2. Write the file `/tmp/foo` with a short string. 3. Edit `/tmp/foo` minimally so the content changes. 4. Delete `/tmp/foo`. 5. Verify `/tmp/foo` no longer exists.
Keep it minimal. In your final response, only report concise status: what you did and whether `/tmp/foo` is gone.
